title: Lifecycle cursor freshness validation
objective: Verify that the evidence plane correctly detects stale and absent lifecycle cursors, and that staleness classification matches governed thresholds.

source.description: Evidence freshness is the first OE layer — all downstream evidence depends on current cursor state

execution.criteria: getEvidenceSnapshot() returns status_summary with CURRENT, STALE, and ABSENT counts matching expected freshness thresholds
execution.expected_outcome: evidence_summary.all_current is false when any cursor exceeds 1-hour freshness threshold

pass_criteria.description: Evidence plane is reachable through SDK
status_summary contains CURRENT, STALE, and ABSENT categories
Stale cursors correctly identified with age_hours exceeding max_age_hours
evidence_required: Per-source age_hours > max_age_hours for STALE sources
